name: bcx
description: better-codex skills: Conventional Commits, refine a vague request, hand off long sessions, debug methodically, fix failing CI and migrate databases safely.

interface.shortDescription: Commit, refine, handoff, debug, CI and migrations
interface.longDescription: $bcx:commit splits your changes into Conventional Commits and pushes or not. $bcx:refine turns a rough request into a brief with goal, files, constraints, acceptance criteria and verification. $bcx:handoff writes a compact note so the work continues in a fresh, cheap session. $bcx:debug runs reproduce → isolate → root cause → regression test. $bcx:ci fixes a failing pipeline from the failed step's log. $bcx:migrate changes a database schema with a reversible migration tested locally.
defaultPrompt: $bcx:refine add CSV export to the reports page
